si_usage.status: Prepared using SI-assisted code; source observations are not SI-generated
si_usage.synthetic_arrays: Unit-test fixtures only; not exported as observations

thresholds_role: First-date compatibility values; use per-date analysis thresholds

grid.area_basis: Projected UTM pixel squares; grid spacing is not effective resolution

analysis.reference_policy: Complete coarse cells in actual cached AOI outside projected geographic reservoir bbox; cache extends approximately 600 m around bbox. Not a ground-truth land mask or the review screenshot's 5.1 km reference.

overview.role: approximate full-frame location context only; not quantitative georeferencing
overview.grid_basis: actual GCOV coordinate centres and 17x browse reduction

processing.filter: 3x3 normalized linear-power mean; invalid centres preserved
processing.reprojection: fixed EPSG:3857; bilinear power, nearest validity
processing.analysis: Separate native UTM 30 m linear-area-average grid; HH relative reference ratio 0.6
processing.separation_definition: (median dB in 150–300 ground-metre exterior ring minus median dB inside OSM polygon) / sqrt((variance inside + variance ring) / 2). Spatial contrast only; reference ring is not verified land truth and polygon interior is not verified water truth.
processing.effective_resolution: grid spacing is not effective spatial resolution
